tools.name: get_shop
tools.description: Get the authenticated shop's storefront profile, trust score, and live listing count.

tools.name: update_shop
tools.description: Edit the storefront profile. Sparse — only the fields you send change.

tools.name: list_listings
tools.description: List the shop's listings (all statuses). Keyset-paginated — pass the returned next_cursor to page.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get one of the shop's listings by id (any status).

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: Create a listing. Image URLs may be public — they are re-hosted to first-party storage automatically.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: Edit one of the shop's listings (sparse). Image URLs may be public — re-hosted automatically. A job's pay is `salaryM`; a `price` sent for a job is read as its monthly salary in VND. An edit of a listing that is waiting for eno's licence check answers `held: true`: the listing stays unpublished unti

tools.name: set_listing_status
tools.description: Set a listing's availability: active | sold | hidden. Re-activating a listing that is waiting for eno's licence check is refused with `licence_check_required` until eno approves it.

tools.name: delete_listing
tools.description: Delete one of the shop's listings. While the shop or the listing is under investigation (an open report, or the account is held/suspended) it is hidden instead — the result then says `deleted: false, hidden: true` and why.

tools.name: bulk_create_listings
tools.description: Create up to 200 listings in one call. Each is independent; image URLs are re-hosted.

tools.name: sync_catalogue
tools.description: Upsert the catalogue by your own externalId. mode "partial" only touches sent rows; "full" also retires listings absent from the payload. Up to 200 rows.

tools.name: analytics_summary
tools.description: Shop-level totals: views, leads, and listing counts by status.

tools.name: analytics_listings
tools.description: Per-listing daily views + leads (deltas) over a date range, plus totals. Keyset-paginated.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List the shop's registered webhook endpoints (secrets are never returned) with delivery health.

tools.name: register_webhook
tools.description: Register an HTTPS endpoint for signed listing events. The signing secret is returned ONCE — store it.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Unregister a webhook endpoint by id.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_webhooks" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: update_listing · Private data: list_webhooks, register_webhook · Public sink: update_shop, list_webhooks, register_webhook, delete_webhook · Destructive: delete_listing, delete_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: update_listing · Private data: list_webhooks, register_webhook · Public sink: update_shop, list_webhooks, register_webhook, delete_webhook · Destructive: delete_listing, delete_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
